data_window.source: src.ingestion.jaipur_simulator.generate_jaipur_weather + src.ingestion.synthetic_forecast.simulate_day_ahead_forecast (synthetic, deterministic given these seeds -- not stored, regenerable by re-running `make train`)

train_test_split_metrics.note: not the real evaluation -- see benchmark.py's rolling-origin backtest and final holdout in this same file, under rolling_origin_backtest / final_holdout

target: capacity_factor (solar_output_mw / plant's ac_capacity_mw, range 0-1) -- NOT raw MW. Serving code must multiply predictions by the REQUESTED plant's ac_capacity_mw. This is what lets one model serve multiple differently-sized plants (roadmap P1.1).
